history.body: Hey, your Pearl Residences ad came up. Just browsing for now — what’s the starting price and what’s the main appeal?

For eligible categories, the base-after-rebate reference is about RM302,000; the final price depends on the selected unit and parking. The main appeal is a 900 sq. ft. layout with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony. Are you looking for your own stay or investment?
Mostly for myself, but there’s no rush—I’m just browsing. RM302k is a bit more than I expected; does that vary much depending on the unit?

Yes, it can vary by unit category and parking allocation. RM302k is a base-after-rebate reference; the selected unit’s price can differ. Since it’s for your own stay, the 900 sq. ft. 3-bedroom layout may be worth seeing in person. No rush—would weekdays or weekends suit you better for a visit?

Neither yet, honestly—I’m still just browsing, so not ready to arrange a visit. The 3 bedrooms caught my eye, but I’d need a good reason to move, and the monthly cost matters on one income. Any rough idea what the monthly payment might be?

For the 900 sq. ft. layout, maintenance works out to about RM162 a month (RM0.18 per sq. ft., including sinking fund; an estimate subject to latest confirmation). That’s separate from the mortgage. Loan instalments depend on the amount financed, tenure and bank rate, so I can’t give a reliable figure without those details.
